propositions: Documentation and docstrings across maintained guidance still describe current plan-review, completion-verifier, and verify-signature behavior as HMAC-based when they now mint and verify asymmetric DSSE and SSHSIG operation-certificates

Current operation-certificate attestation uses Ed25519 asymmetric signing and environment-based trust (per ADR 0049) not symmetric HMAC, requiring all maintained public API and docstring descriptions to reflect DSSE/SSHSIG contract
Legacy HMAC operation-certificate records remain readable for backward compatibility but cannot certify a current gated operation; this legacy status must be explicitly stated in guidance

Generic HMAC helper utilities outside operation-certificate gates (rebar.signing.compute_signature, verify_record, signing-key) remain intentionally supported and must retain accurate API documentation separate from current asymmetric op-cert behavior

Generated reference artifacts (docs/mcp-reference.md from scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py, docs/cli-reference.md from scripts/gen_cli_reference.py) must be regenerated through canonical sources to reflect current asymmetric operation-certificate shapes and verdicts
